headline: Ownership Fighting Shifts Toward Central Fronts
war_summary: The latest returns show the ownership struggle broadening beyond Callahan’s Passage. That sector still leads with 79 events in 24 hours, including three in the latest two-hour window, but casualty, enlistment, and event momentum have cooled sharply from the preceding period. Stlican Shelf recorded 43 daily events and remains divided between six Colonial and three Warden bases; its Warden casualty rate is accelerating despite a quieter immediate ledger. Weathered Expanse also remains unsettled, with 31 events, five in two hours, and its balance now standing at seven Colonial and two Warden bases. Nevish Line has quickened to 17 daily events, four recently, while its split is seven Warden to one Colonial base. Stonecradle is the freshest flashpoint: seven events arrived in two hours, alongside accelerating casualties, with seven Colonial bases, one Warden base, and one neutral. Linn Mercy has only six daily events, but three came in the latest two hours as both casualty rates and enlistments accelerated; ten Colonial and one Warden base remain on the books. Fisherman’s Row has gone quiet after heavier earlier activity.
